panels.title: Ledger integrity: wallets whose balance differs from their entries
panels.description: Compares each wallet's cached balance with the sum of its ledger entries; a wallet with no entries has balance 0 and is consistent. Green at 0, red above.

panels.title: Transfer conservation: transfers whose entries do not sum to zero
panels.description: Each transfer writes one negative entry for the sender and one positive for the receiver; their sum must be zero. Green at 0, red above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS transfers_not_summing_to_zero
FROM operation o
JOIN (
    SELECT operation_id, SUM(amount_signed) AS total
    FROM ledger_entry
    GROUP BY operation_id
) e ON e.operation_id = o.id
WHERE o.type = 'TRANSFER' AND e.total <> 0;

panels.title: Total money held by all wallets

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(balance) AS total_money_held FROM wallet;
SELECT count(*) AS wallets FROM wallet;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1m'),
       count(*) AS new_wallets
FROM wallet
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Volume moved over time by operation type
panels.description: Each operation counts once, at its own amount; a transfer is not double-counted for its two entries.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(o.created_at, '1m'),
       o.type AS metric,
       SUM(e.amount_moved) AS volume
FROM operation o
JOIN (
    -- One row per operation, its amount: transfers write two entries of the same magnitude.
    SELECT operation_id, MAX(ABS(amount_signed)) AS amount_moved
    FROM ledger_entry
    GROUP BY operation_id
) e ON e.operation_id = o.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.created_at)
GROUP BY 1, o.type
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Net flow over time: deposits minus withdrawals

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(o.created_at, '1m'),
       SUM(CASE o.type WHEN 'DEPOSIT' THEN e.amount_moved
                       WHEN 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN -e.amount_moved
                       ELSE 0 END) AS net_flow
FROM operation o
JOIN (
    SELECT operation_id, MAX(ABS(amount_signed)) AS amount_moved
    FROM ledger_entry
    GROUP BY operation_id
) e ON e.operation_id = o.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Average ticket by operation type
panels.description: Average amount of each operation in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.type AS metric,
       AVG(e.amount_moved) AS average_ticket
FROM operation o
JOIN (
    SELECT operation_id, MAX(ABS(amount_signed)) AS amount_moved
    FROM ledger_entry
    GROUP BY operation_id
) e ON e.operation_id = o.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.created_at)
GROUP BY o.type;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1m'),
       type AS metric,
       count(*) AS operations
FROM operation
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, type
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Busiest wallets by number of entries, top 10

targets.rawSql:
SELECT w.user_id,
       count(*) AS entries
FROM ledger_entry e
JOIN wallet w ON w.id = e.wallet_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
GROUP BY w.user_id
ORDER BY entries DESC
LIMIT 10;
